checks.description: Deployments and StatefulSets must declare spec.replicas >= 2 so voluntary disruptions (node drains, rolling updates) can preserve at least one healthy replica.
checks.remediation: Set spec.replicas to 2 or more, or label a deliberate single-instance database or cache openova.io/singleton-db=true.
checks.title: Workloads must declare 2+ replicas

checks.description: A PodDisruptionBudget with maxUnavailable=0 (or minAvailable equal to the workload's full replica count) wedges every voluntary disruption. This policy rejects PDBs whose maxUnavailable is 0.
checks.remediation: Set maxUnavailable to 1 or more (or a percentage), or use a minAvailable strictly less than the workload's replica count.
checks.title: PodDisruptionBudgets must permit eviction

checks.description: Deployments / StatefulSets with replicas >= 2 must declare topologySpreadConstraints with topologyKey of kubernetes.io/hostname or topology.kubernetes.io/zone, so a single host or AZ failure can't take down every replica.
checks.remediation: Add a topologySpreadConstraint with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname or topology.kubernetes.io/zone.
checks.title: Multi-replica workloads must spread across hostname or zone

checks.description: Every primary container in a Deployment / StatefulSet / DaemonSet must declare both livenessProbe and readinessProbe. Without probes, kubelet can't detect a wedged process and Service can't gate traffic during startup.
checks.remediation: Declare both a livenessProbe and a readinessProbe on every container.
checks.title: Containers must declare liveness and readiness probes

checks.description: Every container must declare resources.requests.cpu AND resources.requests.memory. BestEffort Pods evict first under pressure and can't be reasoned about for capacity planning or per-Org cost rollups.
checks.remediation: Declare resources.requests.cpu and resources.requests.memory on every container.
checks.title: Containers must declare CPU and memory requests

checks.description: Every container should declare resources.limits.cpu AND resources.limits.memory. Without limits, a single Pod can exhaust a node and starve neighbors.
checks.remediation: Declare resources.limits.cpu and resources.limits.memory on every container.
checks.title: Containers should declare CPU and memory limits

checks.description: PersistentVolumeClaims should reference a StorageClass with allowVolumeExpansion=true so storage can grow without rebuilding the volume.
checks.remediation: Choose a StorageClass with allowVolumeExpansion=true, or extend the existing one.
checks.title: PVC StorageClass must allow volume expansion

checks.description: When a HorizontalPodAutoscaler is admitted, its spec.minReplicas must be >= 1 and the targeted workload's declared replicas should not be below the HPA floor. Runtime effectiveness (current ready Pod count) is checked by the compliance-aggregator's hpa.go evaluator (slice W2).
checks.remediation: Set the HorizontalPodAutoscaler's spec.minReplicas to 1 or more.
checks.title: HPA minReplicas must not exceed workload spec.replicas

checks.description: PVCs must declare a Velero backup binding via either annotation `velero.io/backup-volumes` on the owning Pod template OR label `velero.io/managed-by-schedule` on the PVC itself.
checks.remediation: Label the PVC velero.io/managed-by-schedule with the name of a Velero schedule, or annotate the owning Pod template with velero.io/backup-volumes.
checks.title: Stateful workloads must have a Velero backup configured

checks.description: local-path (the k3s built-in provisioner) is ephemeral node-local disk with no cloud block volume behind it — a node replacement destroys the data, invalidating BCP/DR. #3971 forbids it entirely: k3s runs --disable=local-storage and the durable per-provider cloud CSI is the only default StorageClass. This policy fail-closes any PVC / StorageClass / PV that references local-path.
checks.remediation: Omit storageClassName to bind to the durable cluster-default cloud CSI, or name an explicit durable class.
checks.title: Forbid the ephemeral k3s local-path provisioner

checks.description: Workload-rendering resources must carry `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: flux` (the upstream Flux label) OR have an ownerReference pointing at a HelmRelease / Kustomization. Direct kubectl apply is rejected — IaC-first per docs/INVIOLABLE-PRINCIPLES.md #3.
checks.remediation: Add the label app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=flux on metadata.labels, or attach an ownerReference to a HelmRelease or Kustomization.
checks.title: Workloads must be managed by Flux

checks.description: The substrate components listed in docs/DOD.md §A4 (Cilium-agent, Flux, Kyverno, cert-manager, ESO, CNPG-operator, vCluster-syncers) MUST install on the host k3s cluster, never inside a vCluster. A HelmRelease for one of these Blueprints with `spec.kubeConfig` set indicates a misconfigured G92.1 vcluster-placement override.
checks.remediation: Remove the spec.kubeConfig block from the substrate Blueprint's HelmRelease.
checks.title: Substrate Blueprints must install on host k3s

checks.description: Container images must reference a Sovereign-local Harbor proxy registry. Operator configures the allowed glob via .Values.compliancePolicies.harborProxyPull.allowedImagePattern.
checks.remediation: Re-tag the image to pull through the Sovereign's local Harbor, as a proxy-cache path or a native openova-io push.
checks.title: Container images must pull through the Sovereign Harbor proxy

checks.description: Container images must reference an explicit, non-:latest tag (or a @sha256: digest). Floating tags break SHA-pinned audit trails and reproducibility.
checks.remediation: Pin every image to an explicit tag that is not latest, or to a @sha256 digest.
checks.title: Container images must be tag-pinned (no :latest)

checks.description: Pod template should carry prometheus.io/scrape="true" annotation, OR the workload labels declare monitoring.coreos.com/managed=true indicating an operator-managed PodMonitor / ServiceMonitor exists.
checks.remediation: Annotate the Pod template with prometheus.io/scrape="true", or label the workload monitoring.coreos.com/managed="true".
checks.title: Workloads should be Prometheus-scrape-targeted

checks.description: Workloads should declare OpenTelemetry instrumentation via either an `otel-collector` sidecar container OR `instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-*: "true"` annotation on the Pod template (auto-injection by the OTel operator).
checks.remediation: Add an otel-collector sidecar, or annotate the Pod template with an instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-<language> annotation.
checks.title: Workloads should be OTel-instrumented

checks.description: Pods must declare runAsNonRoot=true at Pod or container level AND every container must set readOnlyRootFilesystem=true.
checks.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot=true at Pod or container level and readOnlyRootFilesystem=true on every container.
checks.title: Workloads must run non-root with read-only rootfs

checks.description: Denies UserAccess CRs whose openova.io/org scope differs from the requesting user's org claim, unless the requester is a member of the management Organization with tier=owner. Permissive Audit by default; per-Sovereign overlay flips to Enforce.
checks.remediation: Set the scope's openova.io/org value to your own Organization, or ask the owner of the management Organization to sign the grant.
checks.title: Internal-vs-customer Org boundary on UserAccess

checks.description: Pod templates must declare the `policy.cilium.io/enforced: "true"` label so the catalyst-network controller routes them under the zero-trust mesh. The runtime "is there an actual selecting CNP/CCNP" check lives in the W2 hubble evaluator.
checks.remediation: Add the label policy.cilium.io/enforced="true" to spec.template.metadata.labels.
checks.title: Workloads must be covered by a Cilium L7 policy

checks.description: Namespaces must contain at least one NetworkPolicy or CiliumNetworkPolicy so east-west traffic is mediated.
checks.remediation: Add at least one NetworkPolicy or CiliumNetworkPolicy to the namespace.
checks.title: Namespaces must declare at least one NetworkPolicy

checks.description: Container env entries with names matching *PASSWORD* / *TOKEN* / *KEY* / *SECRET* must use valueFrom.secretKeyRef, not a plaintext value.
checks.remediation: Source the value from a Secret with valueFrom.secretKeyRef instead of a plaintext value.
checks.title: Plaintext secrets must not appear in container env

checks.description: §854 (founder #1 ABSOLUTE ban): a Service must never be type=NodePort, and a type=LoadBalancer Service must set allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts=false so it does not silently allocate nodePorts. The gateway is served DIRECT (cilium LB-IPAM VIP or a shared address, or Local-ETP + hostPort), never a nodePort. Ships Audit; Enforce is the deliberate follow-up (#5088). cert-manager HTTP-01 solver Services are carved out.
checks.remediation: Expose the Service directly instead: a ClusterIP Service fronted by a gateway route, or the cilium LB-IPAM address.
checks.title: Forbid NodePort Services (§854)
